notes: Product roadmap for map.tableslop.org — GM-editable estimates, not diegetic lore. Dates are rough targets.

timeline.title: Discord OAuth + owner/admin/user roles
timeline.notes: Public view; login required to edit borders/coords/world. SQLite auth DB on potato.

timeline.title: GM-drawn region borders lock
timeline.notes: regions-ui.json potato-owned; skip-worktree + guard scripts; never wipe GM polys.

timeline.title: Phone / Radio / Sim / Cast HUD docks
timeline.notes: Orange idle → turquoise active; expand over cast/info panel; Cast at end of strip.

timeline.title: 3D overlay toggle on 2D map
timeline.notes: Google Maps-style overlay; PCs/routines stay on 2D when off.

timeline.title: World editor (/world) + SoT dashboard
timeline.notes: Separate page from map; cast + weather/regions modules; admin-gated.

timeline.title: World Quick create / character ingest
timeline.notes: Portrait + dump → registry + sheet (no LLM); POST /api/world/characters/ingest.

timeline.title: Pin localStorage override discipline
timeline.notes: Discard coord_overrides when Edit is off; restore server markers on Edit exit.

timeline.title: Dev calendar HUD panel
timeline.notes: Green dev log chip → timeline / features / bugs; JSON SoT under projects/tableslop/.

timeline.title: Mobile map rebuild
timeline.notes: Phone currently stubs map (≤800px); journal + docks only until rebuild.

features.title: World editor page
features.notes: Cast roster, Quick create, weather/SoT cards — not a Hub escape hatch.

features.title: Dev calendar / Dev log on map HUD
features.notes: GM-facing product calendar of features + bugs.

features.title: Phone HOME launcher apps (Texts / Contacts / commerce)
features.notes: Multi-app shell already docks; deepen in-world apps next.

features.title: Cast templates + undo on map product
features.notes: Move more Chars/Stories into map/worldeditor surfaces.

bugs.title: Pin positions drift via localStorage coord_overrides
bugs.notes: Mitigated 2026-08-09: ignore/discard overrides when Edit off. Hard-refresh if stale client still holds overrides.

bugs.title: Mobile map blocked (intentional stub)
bugs.notes: ≤800px hides map viewport; stub copy points to desktop. Rebuild tracked as timeline tl-mobile-map.

bugs.title: OpenRouter :free 429 independent of USD balance
bugs.notes: Ops/chat concern more than map UI; failover must rotate free pool.
